title.zh: 只计自身的取用漏掉联合超出：各自在所给之内，合起来可以超出；联合超出持续不过原有的；更新者依存于所更新者时，它终结更新与以其所需依存者，取用者以这样的需要依存时也在内
title.en: Counting one's own draw misses joint excess: each within what is given, together they can exceed it; joint excess cannot outlast what was held; where renewers depend on what they renew, it ends the renewal and those depending at such a need, a taker among them where it so depends

claim.zh: 一步中每个参与的形成从一个条件取用都不多于该步给予它的，称为各自在所给之内（Flow.WithinOwn）；它们合起来取用不多于所给，称为联合地在所给之内（Flow.WithinJoint）。各自在所给之内，合起来可以超出（Pair.own_not_joint）。在平衡的流中，联合地在所给之内时水平不下降（Flow.joint_keeps）；联合超出的一步使水平至少下降一（Flow.excess_lowers），所以连续 n 步联合超出需要起点水平至少为 n（Flow.excess_bounded）；两个形成每步各取一单位、只给回一单位时，没有任何网使流平衡（Pair.no_web）。每个向条件给予的形成都以至少 m 的需要依存于它、只有活跃者给予（Acting）、活动需要支持（Dependent）时，水平一旦低于 m，以后每步都低于 m（Flow.stays_below），以至少 m 的需要依存于它的每个形成从那以后都不活跃（Flow.ends_below）；所以从低于 n + m 的水平起连续 n 步联合超出，终结更新者与以至少 m 的需要依存于该条件的每个形成，取用者以这样的需要依存时也在内；不依存或以较低需要依存的取用者可以延续（Flow.joint_excess_ends）。Exceeding 中一个更新者给予两单位，两个取用者各取两单位，每个都在所给之内，满足平衡、Acting、Dependent 与给予的门控，从第二步起三者都不活跃（Exceeding.all_end；这一终结也由其活动规定，见证表明它与这些定律相容）；只有一个取用者时，同一更新者保持水平，二者每步都活跃（Alone.all_continue）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: A formation's take from a condition across a step is within what is given when no formation taking part takes more than the step gives the condition (Flow.WithinOwn); the formations take jointly within what is given when their total take is at most what is given (Flow.WithinJoint). Each can take within what is given while together they take more (Pair.own_not_joint). In a balanced flow, taking jointly within what is given keeps the level (Flow.joint_keeps); a step of joint excess lowers it by at least one (Flow.excess_lowers), so n consecutive steps of joint excess need a level of at least n at the start (Flow.excess_bounded), and with two formations each taking a unit at every step and one unit given back no web balances the flow (Pair.no_web). Where every formation giving to the condition depends on it at a need of at least m, only active formations give (Acting) and activity needs support (Dependent), a level below m stays below m at every later step (Flow.stays_below), and every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m is inactive from then on (Flow.ends_below); so n consecutive steps of joint excess from a level below n + m end the renewers and every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m, a taker among them where it so depends; a taker not depending on it, or depending at a lower need, can continue (Flow.joint_excess_ends). In Exceeding a renewer gives two units and two takers each take two, each within what the step gives; balance, Acting, Dependent and the gate hold, and from step two on none of the three is active (Exceeding.all_end; the ending is also stipulated in its activity, and the witness shows it consistent with these laws); with one taker the same renewer keeps the level and both are active at every step (Alone.all_continue). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 平衡：条件水平的每次变化都是参与者的取用与给予。
hypotheses.en: Balance: every change of a condition's level is what those taking part take and give.

hypotheses.zh: 门控：每个向条件给予的形成都以至少 m 的需要依存于它；只有活跃者给予（Acting）；活动需要支持（Dependent）。这是更新依存于所更新者的形式，不是一般的更新。
hypotheses.en: The gate: every formation giving to the condition depends on it at a need of at least m; only active formations give (Acting); activity needs support (Dependent). This is renewal depending on what it renews, not renewal in general.

hypotheses.zh: 超出的计数是每步的总量，不问每个取用者的份额；各自在所给之内比较的是每个取用者与该步的全部给予。
hypotheses.en: Excess is counted on totals at each step, not on shares; within what is given compares each taker with the whole of the step's giving.

correspondence.zh: Ren 的提议说，自我可以变得僵硬，“has to count the dynamics that happens beyond what the "self" sees”。外围的磨损定律已有同一现象：两个部分各在更新之内、只合起来超出时，共享的形成随之终止（renewing-consuming-formation 中的 jointly_exceeding_parts_end_shared_formation）。本结果把它陈述在脊柱上，以支持门控的网的形式，不用磨损定律：更新者依存于所更新者，联合超出使水平低于其需要，更新停止，以其所需依存者终结，取用者以这样的需要依存时也在内。两个模型没有实例定理相连，联系是诠释性的。作者的读法（AI 论证）：元吸引子选出取用更多的形成，它们起初形成更多，每步的计数偏好它们；各自只计自身的取用，合起来超出更新，共享的条件终结，以其所需依存于它的随之终结，胜者如此依存时也在内。想要的延续比共享条件所存更长远时，它必须计入对其所依存者的联合取用；n 步联合超出只需要 n 的水平，视界较短的想要可以在联合超出中被全部满足（Mortal，见 derived-extent-limits）。这是想要所要求的，不是对它的判决。
correspondence.en: Ren's proposal says that the self can become rigid and “has to count the dynamics that happens beyond what the "self" sees”. The periphery's wear law has the same phenomenon: where two parts are each within renewal and only jointly exceed it, the shared formation ceases with them (jointly_exceeding_parts_end_shared_formation in renewing-consuming-formation). This result states it on the spine, as a support-gated web and without the wear law: renewers depend on what they renew, joint excess brings the level below their need, renewal stops and those depending at such a need end, a taker among them where it so depends. No instance theorem joins the two models; the link is interpretive. The author's reading (an AI argument): the meta-attractor selects formations that take more; they form more at first and a count over a step prefers them; each counts its own draw, together they exceed renewal, the shared condition ends, and with it what depends on it at such a need, the winners among them where they so depend. A formation that wants its continuation beyond what the shared condition holds must count the joint draw on what it depends on; n steps of joint excess need only a level of n, so a want with a shorter horizon can be fully met amid joint excess (Mortal, see derived-extent-limits). This is what the want requires, not a verdict passed on it.

detail.zh: 复用平衡（Flow.Balances）、只有活跃者给予（Flow.Acting）与 taken、given 的总量。
detail.en: Reuses balance (Flow.Balances), only active formations giving (Flow.Acting) and the totals taken and given.

output.zh: 平衡的流：水平加取用等于原水平加给予。
output.en: A balanced flow: the level with what is taken is the level before with what is given.

input.zh: 联合超出的每一步使水平至少下降一。
input.en: Each step of joint excess lowers the level by at least one.

conditions.zh: 平衡；门控的结论另需 Acting 与 Dependent。
conditions.en: Balance; the gated conclusions also need Acting and Dependent.

detail.zh: 外围在一类磨损定律中已有联合超出终止共享形成；本结果在脊柱的支持门控网中陈述同一现象，没有实例定理。
detail.en: The periphery has joint excess ending a shared formation in one wear-law class; this result states the same phenomenon in the spine's support-gated web, with no instance theorem.

detail.zh: 单个消耗者超出更新时，维持者永久失去支持；本结果是联合的情形。
detail.en: A single consumer exceeding renewal makes the sustainer lose its support for good; this result is the joint case.

detail.zh: 联合超出中单个部分可以不造成差别，而联合的取用仍终结依存者；归属与损失分开。
detail.en: In joint excess no single part need make the difference while the joint draw still ends the dependents; attribution and loss come apart.

detail.zh: 推出的范围达不到的：单向、想要的视界与清除者。
detail.en: What the derived extent does not reach: one way, the horizon of the want and the clearer.

detail.zh: 各自在所给之内不足以延续：Exceeding 中每个取用者都在所给之内，三者都在两步后终结（Exceeding.all_end）；同一更新者只有一个取用者时都延续（Alone.all_continue）。
detail.en: Each within what is given is not enough to continue: in Exceeding each taker is within what is given and all three end after two steps (Exceeding.all_end); with one taker the same renewer and taker continue (Alone.all_continue).

detail.zh: 没有平衡时联合超出可以永远持续的描述不是任何平衡网的流：Pair 中没有网使流平衡（Pair.no_web）。
detail.en: A description in which joint excess goes on for ever is the flow of no balanced web: in Pair no web balances the flow (Pair.no_web).

limitations.zh: 只对离散步与自然数的量陈述；门控的结论只对依存于所更新者的更新成立，不对外部来源（如太阳）给予的更新成立；超出比较的是每步的总量，不处理储备与延迟的更新；Exceeding 与 Alone 是最小的见证，Exceeding 的终结由其活动规定，见证表明它与定律相容；联合计入只约束比条件所存更长远的想要，取用者只在以这样的需要依存时随之终结；与外围磨损定律的联系是诠释性的；不含伦理谓词，也不说哪个取用者应当减少；名称是 AI 的表述，由 Ren 定（WithinOwn、WithinJoint、Exceeding、Alone 等）。
limitations.en: Stated for discrete steps and natural-number amounts; the gated conclusions hold only for renewal that depends on what it renews, not for renewal given from an outside source such as a sun; excess compares totals at each step and treats neither reserves nor delayed renewal; Exceeding and Alone are minimal witnesses, Exceeding's ending is stipulated in its activity and shown consistent with the laws; the joint count binds only a want that outlasts what the condition holds, and a taker ends with it only where it depends at such a need; the link to the periphery's wear law is interpretive; contains no ethical predicate and does not say which taker ought to take less; the names are the AI's wording, for Ren to choose (WithinOwn, WithinJoint, Exceeding, Alone and others).

validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261010T083222.285294Z): the 40 theorems of Becoming.Continuation all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 29 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 1356 theorems/2161 declaration audits, and 15 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261010T084107.973758Z passed. The author's counterreview is in §47 of the integration note; the independent review (CONTINUATION-GROUNDING-REVIEW.md) accepts its Lean, and its corrections are handled in §47.1–47.4 of the integration note. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 31 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).

next_delta.zh: 与 RelationalRenewal 的支持门控定律及外围磨损定律的实例定理；储备与延迟更新下的联合超出；份额与归属（不推出责任）。
next_delta.en: Instance theorems to RelationalRenewal's support-gated law and the periphery's wear law; joint excess under reserves and delayed renewal; shares and attribution (responsibility does not follow).
